name: Relic Custodian
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, Gain 2 Aura if you control an Artifact.

name: Mended Oath
rules_text: Return target Seal card with Energy cost 2 or less from your Pit to your hand. Gain 2 Aura.

name: Archivist of Vows
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, return target Artifact or Seal card with Energy cost 2 or less from your Pit to play.

name: Inkwell Diver
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, Pick a card, then put a card from your hand into the Pit.

name: Borrowed Refrain
rules_text: Return target Mudra card from your Pit to your hand.

name: Keeper of Unwritten Names
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, return target Mudra or Mantra card from your Pit to your hand. Then return up to one target creature to its owner's hand.

name: Fen Memorialist
rules_text: When this creature is put into the Pit from play, put the top 2 cards of your deck into the Pit.

name: Grave Due
rules_text: Return target creature card from your Pit to your hand. Target opponent loses 2 Aura if that card has Energy cost 4 or greater.

name: Votary of the Last Debt
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, return target creature card from your Pit to play Turned.

name: Kiln Rummager
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, you may put a card from your hand into the Pit. If you do, Pick a card.

name: Kindling Recall
rules_text: Extinguish the top two cards of your deck. You may play those cards this Round.

name: Embervault Smith
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, it deals 3 damage to target creature. You may put an Artifact card from your hand into the Pit. If you do, this creature deals 2 damage to each opponent.

name: Moss Ledger
rules_text: Return target Land card from your Pit to your hand. Gain 2 Aura.

name: Hollowroot Forager
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, return up to one target Land card from your Pit to your hand.

name: Elder of Ring and Root
rules_text: When this creature comes into play, return up to one target Land card from your Pit to play Turned and up to one target creature card from your Pit to your hand.
